مَغْموُرٌ [Overflowed, or covered, and concealed, by water, &c. ―
-b2- ] Rained upon. (TA.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) Overcome, subdued, or oppressed. (TA.) ―
-b4- (assumed tropical:) An obscure man; of no reputation: (K, TA:) as though others surpassed him. (TA.) You say also, فُلَانٌ مغْمُورُ النَّٰسَبِ (assumed tropical:) Such a one is of obscure race. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
